notes.title: Massive Localisation Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, good news! I've finally updated the game with a massive localisation update. This will mean the following languages are now supported: 
- Chinese Traditional
- Chinest Simplified
- French
- German
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Portuguese
- Spanish

Also a variety of fixes have been made over the last 6 months that should improve the game overall. 

Please let me know if you experience any issues and thanks for hanging in there!

notes.title: Major Performance Update!!!
notes.notes:
Forest Farm has had a major performance update. 

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Valve Index and HTC Vive Supported!
notes.notes:
I'm proud to announce that Forest Farm can now be played on Index and Vive headsets.

Thanks to the community for your support!

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Crafting Update - Craft your own houses and decorate them!
notes.notes:
This month I've been working on adding a large variety of items for players to craft.

This includes houses, giant mushrooms, fences, raised beds and more.

I hope you all enjoy the update. 

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Introducing the Mushroom Kingdom!!!
notes.notes:
Get ready to explore a completely new zone in Forest Farm!

New characters, new quests and new areas to explore!

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Forest Farm Livestream!
notes.notes:
Join me for a livestream of Forest Farm! 

Learn how to grow fruits and vegetables, craft fences, complete quests and upgrade your tools.

Celebrate Simfest Hobby Edition 2022 with us!

notes.title: Improved tools and upgrades!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

This week I've upgraded the farming tools! This is a huge visual upgrade from the previous tools and I hope they're a bit more impressive. Next week I plan to finish off the PC version of the game to allow everyone to play.

Buy now on App Lab, Oculus Rift Store and Steam!!!

App Lab: https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4321051927921217/

Oculus Store: https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/2971486562963289/

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1403520/Forest_Farm/

SideQuest: https://sidequestvr.com/app/4729/forest-farm

Discord: https://discord.gg/KZnRdev

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: New and Improved Vegetable Crops
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

This week I've been working on improving the visual quality of the ground cover crops.

We now have lettuce, cabbage and cauliflower to grow and harvest!

Stay tuned as a lot of things will be added over the next couple of weeks, including a huge update to the tools.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Discover the forest spirits!!!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

This week I've been working on adding a more fantasy vibe to the game by adding Forest Spirits. These will come in a couple of different species and this is the first to be added. They will be found deep in the forest and will help players by supplying seeds and buying more specific items that players can craft. Stay tuned, much more to come!

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Complete UI Overhaul
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

I've been working on replacing the old user interfaces with a new style and format to match the fantasy setting.

I hope everyone enjoys the changes and please let me know how you feel about it on Discord!

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Index Laser Angle - Fixed
notes.notes:
Players using the Valve Index can enjoy Forest Farm again!!!

It took me a few weeks but I've finally solved the index laser angle issues.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Horse Whisperer - Call over your horse by making a loud noise in the microphone
notes.notes: Use your microphone to call over your trusty steed, allowing quick access to the horse and cart storage or simply for a faster ride!

notes.title: Ride your horse and cart into the city to deliver your fruit and vegetables
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

I'm making major changes to the core quest line in Forest Farm.

The start of this involves allowing the player to ride on the horse and cart. This enables players to store produce in the cart and ride it into town at a faster pace than walking, which in the future will be the main location to pickup quests to complete. 

I hope players enjoy it and please let me know how you feel on Discord.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: New Options Menu - Access by grabbing your utility watch!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

I've been working to improve the look and function of the options in Forest Farm and have settled on giving the player a utility watch to grab which will allow them to setup the following options:

Locomotion Options:
Snap Turn
Smooth Turn
Teleport
Increase/Decrease Smooth turn Speed

Game Options:
Rigid Tools
Music On/Off

I hope it makes the game more accessible for players and please let me know what you think on Discord.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Rain for your fruit and vegetable crops
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I've implemented the rain system today. 

At each transition between morning, midday, evening and night, there will be a 1/6 chance for rain to strike. This is both an atmospheric effect, and also practical as it will water any crops that have seeds and are waiting for water.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Inventory Bag/Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
The Inventory system has finally been added. This allows players to store all produce, seeds and anything foraged from the forest. 

This allows for much quicker and efficient planting of gardens and makes it much more enjoyable.

All tutorial signs have also been removed and replaced with a friendly NPC who will guide you through the basics of the game.

I feel this is a significant improvement on the overall look of the game and I hope you all enjoy.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Smooth Turn Adjustment
notes.notes:
Buttons have been added to allow players to fine tune their smooth turning.

Find them on the side of the house with the rest of the options.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Trading Post Update - Trade fruit and vegetables for gold coins
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

I've added the Trading Post, which will allow players to trade the produce they've grown for gold coins!

Gold coins will be used to purchase upgrades to the farm such as the barn, more animals, chicken coop and more.

More traders to come; magic scarecrow, lumber yard (for buying buildings) and the animal dealer.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Valve Index is now officially supported!!!
notes.notes:
Index users can now play Forest Farm!

Happy Farming!

notes.title: Lighter Tools - For easy tool use
notes.notes: Updated the weight of the tools to make them easier to use

notes.title: Distance Grab - The beginnings
notes.notes:
Today I've implemented the basics of the distance grab function. 

This allows players to grab produce from a distance, no longer having to bend over to get the job done.

Happy Farming!!!

notes.title: Discord Link
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Here is the Discord link: https://discord.gg/KZnRdev

Please join the Discord if you are having any issues and I'll be happy to work through them with you. 

Also please feel free to join the discussion to suggest or critique the game.

Looking forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: Tutorial On/Off Button Added
notes.notes: Players that have grasped the basics of the game can now press the Tutorial Off button, disabling all tutorials, cleaning up the look of your farm!

notes.title: Index Controls Fix Attempt - headset not officially supported
notes.notes:
Attempting to address control issues with Valve Index.

Please comment to assist me with diagnosing the issues.

[h1]Developing Forest Farm - Full Version

notes.title: Clarity Update - Tutorials Added
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Clarity Update![/h1]

Tutorials have now been added to the Forest Farm Demo which will assist players to understand how to play and what they can get up to in the forest.

Main Tutorials:
Gardening
Fishing
Wood Felling
Fence Moving

Please give the game a try in the upcoming Steam Game Festival!

[h3]Happy Gardening![/h3]

notes.title: Forest Farm - Gardening Live Stream
notes.notes:
[h1]Time to build a community garden![/h1]

Join me as I play the full version of Forest Farm and design and grow a garden from scratch.

I'll be taking suggestions on Discord and building the garden collaboratively.

This will teach players how to play as well as allowing a preview of the actual Forest Farm!

Come join in and contribute!

notes.title: Forest Farm - Gardening Demo Live Stream
notes.notes:
[h1]Let's kick off the Festival![/h1]

Join us during the start of the Steam Game Festival, where we will be live streaming Forest Farm with the community!

During the Live Stream we will also be running a Q&A to answer any questions about the game and where it's headed.

Come join the fun when we share some previously unseen features and content of the full version, preview the demo and much more!
